nodes.name: Read Text or Attachment

nodes.name: Prepare Extraction
nodes.notes: One structured extraction call per report. No autonomous tools; no model-based arithmetic.

nodes.name: AI - Extract Weekly Report
nodes.notes: Select the existing OpenAI credential. No secret is embedded. An HTTP error is routed into the validation/review path; not treated as a valid report.

nodes.name: Validate Extracted Report
nodes.notes: Check schema, dates, unique SKUs, nonnegative amounts, exact source excerpts and daily/weekly reconciliation. Missing numeric data stays null.

nodes.name: Review Required
nodes.notes: Invalid/incomplete extraction produces a downloadable review result. Never silently invent or zero-fill facts.

nodes.name: Calculate Weekly Metrics
nodes.notes: Contribution = revenue - paid refunds - sold-unit landed cost - flat demo Amazon fees - ads. Not net profit. Initial stock purchases are not expensed again.

nodes.name: Build Daily Chart Series
nodes.notes: Use supplied daily rows only. Missing values stay null; coverage is explicit. Never divide weekly totals into fake daily sales.

nodes.name: Assess Stock and Lead Time
nodes.notes: Snapshot as of period end. Simulate arrival-aware stock until a new order becomes sellable. Supplier-delay notices are review tasks, not automatic ETA edits.

nodes.name: Prioritize Action Inbox
nodes.notes: AI extracts event meaning; explicit rules set priority. Returns never automatically create refunds. Account notices require verification in Seller Central.

nodes.name: Build Dashboard Result
nodes.notes: Versioned JSON for a future dashboard: KPIs, products, daily series, stock plans, review samples, action inbox and caveats. No website is deployed.

nodes.name: Download Result JSON
nodes.notes: Download binary dashboard.json from this node. Output is an execution artifact, not a persisted dashboard database.

parameters.content:
## Seller Insights | Weekly Operations

Read left to right on the first row, then left to right on the second.
Weekly report → structured facts → calculations → action inbox → dashboard JSON.
**Synthetic showcase. Gmail OAuth and live AI execution are separate setup/verification steps.**

## 1 · Submit the weekly report

Click **Execute workflow** to open the test form. Review the pre-filled synthetic report and click **Analyze report**.

**Prepare Form Report** preserves your submitted text; it never overwrites it with a fixed sample.

Gmail is an optional, unconnected alternative for a single UTF-8 .txt attachment. No Gmail setup is needed for this demo.

## 2 · Extract and validate

One AI call extracts facts and notification types. Code checks the result.
Bad input / API error / inconsistent daily totals → Review Required.
**Null is unknown, not zero.** The review branch rejoins the download node.

## 3 · Compute the business view

Weekly contribution, TACoS and ACoS. Historical inventory payments stay separate.
Daily chart points come only from supplied dates.
Arrival-aware stock estimate includes production + transit + receiving.

## 4 · Explain and export

Rules prioritize stock gaps, negative contribution, account notices and returns.
Show sample size for reviews; return-request intensity is not a cohort return rate.
Download JSON now; a dashboard can consume it later.

## Demo limits and next connection

No Amazon API, no real business data, no email sending, no orders/refunds executed.
No durable storage or exactly-once claim. Stable report/event IDs help a later dashboard upsert snapshots.
A real Gmail trigger/attachment test is required after OAuth. A schema-valid AI result can still misread a fact.
